LanguageData.DreamFightingBloodspill.label: Dreamt about fighting
LanguageData.DreamFightingBloodspill.description: Breaking their bones is not enough! Let the blood spill!
LanguageData.DreamMurder.label: Dreamt about murder
LanguageData.DreamMurder.description: Motionless body lays in front of me and I watch it. The blood pool keeps getting bigger. I don't remember why I killed this person but it feels so damn good.

LanguageData.DreamMurderingRival.label: Dreamt about murdering rival
LanguageData.DreamMurderingRival.description: I wish they could still be here. To see how much I'm enjoying myself now, after ending their miserable life...
LanguageData.DreamMurderingRival.stages.NoLabel.label: NoLabel
LanguageData.DreamMurderSpree.label: Dreamt about murder spree
LanguageData.DreamMurderSpree.description: Nothing can stop me. Murder. Everyone.

LanguageData.DreamTorturingStranger.label: Dreamt about torturing
LanguageData.DreamTorturingStranger.description: Stranger tied up in front of me. Set of shiny and sharp tools on the table. I grabbed one of the knifes and I couldn't stop. Even when strangers body stopped quivering, I was still taking pleasure in the simple act of torture...
